# PR #2088: Patch: spec check resolves the `§`, `R` and card references inside a ruling's `cards:` line

Closes #2047

## What changed

Rule 5 of `cargo jackioh spec check` now resolves every reference inside each ruling note's `cards:` line: `R<n>` against the ruling notes, `§<n>`/`§<n>.<m>` against the spec headings, and `#<n>`/`#<n>.<k>` against `crates/cards/catalog.json` (set-aware: `C+ #12.1`, `Meditative #40`; a bare `#` inherits the set before it, else Core; `issue #<n>` is an issue, never a card). A dead reference fails the check with a message naming the note, the reference, and where it should exist.

- [spec.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-2047/crates/tools/src/spec.rs): new constants `CATALOG_PATH`, `SET_PREFIXES`, `DEFAULT_SET`, `ISSUE_WORD`; new `CardsRef`, `cards_refs`, `catalog_indices`, `unresolved_cards_refs`; rule 5 in `check` reads the catalog and reports per-note findings; module doc updated; 3 new unit tests.
- [crates/tools README](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-2047/crates/tools/README.md) and [spec README](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-2047/spec/README.md): rule 5 now resolves `cards`; Note format documents the reference shapes.
- 81 ruling notes, `cards:` lines only: 7 old notes gain an explicit `Core` before Core cards that followed a `C+` card (R0384, R0416, R0471, R0593, R0682, R0688, R0766 — each index verified present in the Core set of catalog.json); 74 notes get bare issue numbers reworded to `issue #<n>` (R0670 keeps card `#100`, Ceaseless Void).

## Findings

The new rule found 92 dead references in 81 notes, exactly the planner's count: none were `R` or `§`. 84 were issue numbers written as bare `#<n>` across 74 notes; 8 were Core cards in 7 notes misread as Classic+ after a `C+` card. After the fixes the tree is clean.

## How tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh spec::` — 23 passed, including the 3 new tests (scanner shapes, flagging dead ruling/section/card, catalog indices).
- `cargo jackioh spec check` — `spec check: 1296 rulings, 2951 proofs, 41676 citations in 2771 files, 15820 links: ok`.
- Negative probe: `Core #9999` in R0195's `cards:` fails with ``spec/rulings/R0195.md: `cards` names Core #9999, which is no card in crates/cards/catalog.json (an issue is written `issue #<n>`)`` / `spec check: 1 problem(s)`; restored, clean again, no diff left.
- `cargo jackioh spec index && git diff --exit-code -- spec/INDEX.md` — INDEX.md byte-identical.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; full `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` green (exit 0).

## Decisions (per plan, alternatives rejected)

- Extended rule 5 rather than adding a rule 8, keeping "seven rules" true.
- No allowlist: only `R`/`§`/`#` shapes are read, so prose (`B47`, `CLAUDE.md rule 4`) never matches and ranges resolve at both ends; issue numbers were reworded to `issue #<n>` instead of whitelisted.
- Bare `#` inherits the preceding set (the spec's `C+ #12.1 to #12.8` convention); defaulting to Core was rejected (would fail ~70 correct references).
- Catalog ids and `T-…` names are not read (`T-AI-1` exists in two sets); catalog read from `<root>/crates/cards/catalog.json` so `--root` is honoured.
- One departure, cosmetic only: `cargo fmt` reflowed the rule-5 insertion (`fs::read_to_string…?` split over two lines).

## For the reviewer

Two count notes: the summary line reads 15820 links, not the planner's 15762 — link counting is untouched by this change, so the difference is tree drift since planning. The diff touches 84 files (81 rulings, each exactly one `cards:` line — verified zero non-`cards:` diff lines — plus spec.rs and two READMEs); `spec/INDEX.md`, `catalog.json`, and `patches/` are untouched.

### Adversarial review
